subject: Medivox: isolation readiness & operator scope — RFP questions
messages:
From: Claire Roberts <claire.roberts@medivox.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: isolation requirements and operator scope

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this RFP — attached is the Medivox private deployment appendix (we highlighted sections that are high priority for procurement & infosec). Two specific asks up front:

1) Confirm whether Redwood supports fully isolated VPC deployments with no outbound internet egress from inference host subnet (airlock/egress-proxy model).
2) Provide a table of "operator tasks" that Medivox operations will still need to perform post-install (operator scope), and those Redwood will take responsibility for (including remote support options where allowed).

We'd like a short technical write-up and a staff effort estimate for the operator tasks by next Friday so procurement can present to security.

Attachment: medivox_rfp_v4.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Claire Roberts
Sr. Procurement Manager
Medivox Therapeutics

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Claire Roberts <claire.roberts@medivox.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: isolation requirements and operator scope

Claire — thanks for the RFP and the highlighted appendix. We can support an isolated VPC/airlocked deployment; there are a few variations depending on operator access model and whether Medivox requires hardware-level airgapping or a network airlock with controlled egress via a hardened jump host.

Quick plan:
- We will produce an "Isolation Readiness" technical brief describing egress control options, recommended network diagrams, and expected telemetry/telemetry-exchange patterns.
- We'll attach an operator scope matrix that itemizes tasks (operator account management, patching, model rollback, backups, physical media handling) and indicate which are Redwood-managed vs customer-managed.
- For effort estimates, we will provide a 0/30/60/90-day staffing estimate for onboarding and an ongoing 1-year support profile.

Marissa / Logan — can you review the matrix draft attached and suggest changes before I send the formal response to Claire? I tagged a few uncertain items in the worksheet.

Thanks — I'll aim to send the formal package by Fri 18 Sep.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0139

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: isolation requirements and operator scope

Vanessa / Logan — reviewed. I've added technical clarifications to the attached operator_scope_matrix.xlsx and a short appendix describing our preferred egress patterns. High-level notes:

- Network options: (A) Fully isolated VPC with importer/exporter physical media path + airlock appliance; (B) Isolated VPC with outbound whitelisted egress via a hardened bastion/proxy (recommended where physical airgapping is impractical).
- Telemetry: We can keep local telemetry for 180 days by default; exports must be pushed via signed artifacts on customer schedule. We can disable all active phone-home if required.
- Patching: Redwood offers an operator-assisted patch bundle. For customers who require no remote update, we provide signed patch artifacts and a runbook for offline installation; for customers who allow remote patching, we provide a scheduled maintenance window and operator escalation contact.

Attachments: operator_scope_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

I flagged three cells where we need legal to confirm SLA language around operator error and rollback responsibilities.

-Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Claire Roberts <claire.roberts@medivox.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood technical response — isolation readiness & operator scope (Medivox RFP MDX-2026-0918)

Claire,

Attached is our technical response to the Medivox appendix. Highlights in plain language:

- Isolation support: Redwood supports both hardened network airlock deployments (no outbound egress from inference hosts) and network-isolated VPCs with explicit egress proxy patterns. We include a validated network diagram for each option and a mapping of firewall rules.
- Operator scope: The attached matrix shows: operator tasks (customer responsible): physical media handling, on-site operator account provisioning, and hardware lifecycle; Redwood-managed tasks: runtime upgrades (per agreed maintenance cadence), model packaging & integrity signing, and remote diagnostics (only if remote support is enabled).
- Offline patching: For airgapped installs we provide signed patch artifacts and a step-by-step runbook; we will not perform automatic remote patching unless explicitly authorized.
- Evidence & SLA: We included a short compliance exhibit listing audit logs available locally, retention windows, and the telemetry export process.

Attachments included: redwood_isolation_readiness_v1.2.pdf (pdf); operator_scope_matrix.xlsx (xlsx); redwood_deployment_bom.csv (csv)

Next steps: please confirm which isolation model Medivox prefers (physical airlock vs proxy-bastion) and whether remote diagnostics may be enabled for priority incident support. Once confirmed we will produce a binding Statement of Work and an estimated onboarding resource plan (hours & roles).

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0139

From: Claire Roberts <claire.roberts@medivox.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@medivox.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medivox.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical response — isolation readiness & operator scope (Medivox RFP MDX-2026-0918)

Vanessa — thank you, this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few clarifications before we request legal to draft SOW:

1) For the "operator tasks (customer)", can you estimate hours for initial onboarding (site prep + operator training) for the physical airlock option? We expect 2 on-site engineers for 3 days as a baseline but need Redwood's view.
2) On telemetry — confirm the exact log types exported in the signed artifact (audit.log, runtime.metrics, model_load_events). We will need field names to map to our SIEM.
3) Please include a short sample runbook excerpt showing the offline patch installation command sequence (not the full runbook) so our on-site engineers can validate tooling compatibility.

If you can get these in a short addendum early next week we'll have procurement & security greenlight to proceed to SOW.

Thanks,
Claire Roberts
Sr. Procurement Manager
Medivox Therapeutics
